# SELIN messianic_laws.5: the new Savior may take the Messianic regime at once
LR_messianic.0005 = {
	type = character_event
	title = LR_messianic.0005.t
	desc = LR_messianic.0005.desc
	theme = faith
	left_portrait = {
		character = root
		animation = personality_zealous
	}

	option = {
		name = LR_messianic.0005.a
		trigger = {
			has_realm_law = LR_soul_messianic_4
			NOT = { LR_has_soul_regime_messianic_trigger = yes }
			OR = {
				has_trait = possessed
				prestige_level >= 4
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_trait = possessed } }
			add_prestige = -500
		}
		LR_soul_regime_set_effect = { REGIME = messianic }
		ai_chance = {
			base = 10
			modifier = { has_trait = possessed factor = 10 }
			modifier = { has_trait = ambitious factor = 5 }
			modifier = { has_trait = arbitrary factor = 5 }
			modifier = { has_trait = lunatic factor = 5 }
			modifier = { has_trait = zealous factor = 2 }
		}
	}
	option = {
		name = LR_messianic.0005.b
		add_piety = 250
		ai_chance = {
			base = 10
			modifier = { has_trait = content factor = 5 }
			modifier = { has_trait = cynical factor = 2 }
			modifier = { has_trait = just factor = 2 }
		}
	}
}

		NOT = { has_character_modifier = LR_messianic_agitation_modifier }
	}

	weight_multiplier = {
		base = 1
		modifier = { has_trait = generous factor = 0.7 }
		modifier = { has_trait = greedy factor = 1.4 }
		modifier = { has_trait = diligent factor = 0.7 }
		modifier = { has_trait = gregarious factor = 0.7 }
		modifier = { has_trait = just factor = 0.7 }
		modifier = { has_trait = lazy factor = 2 }
		modifier = { has_trait = shy factor = 3 }
		modifier = { has_trait = content factor = 1.4 }
		modifier = { has_trait = arbitrary factor = 2 }
		modifier = { learning < 6 factor = 2 }
		modifier = { learning >= 15 factor = 0.7 }
		modifier = { intrigue >= 15 factor = 0.7 }
	}

	option = {
		name = LR_messianic.0006.a
		add_character_modifier = { modifier = LR_messianic_agitation_modifier years = 3 }
		ai_chance = {
			base = 1
			modifier = { has_trait = possessed factor = 10 }
			modifier = { has_trait = ambitious factor = 5 }
			modifier = { has_trait = arbitrary factor = 5 }
			modifier = { has_trait = zealous factor = 2 }
		}
	}
	option = {
		name = LR_messianic.0006.b
		LR_soul_regime_clear_effect = yes
		ai_chance = {
			base = 10
			modifier = { has_trait = content factor = 5 }
			modifier = { has_trait = cynical factor = 2 }
			modifier = { has_trait = just factor = 2 }
